Mod.name: DunkTales in gold room (janky)
Mod.description:
Auto-pickup gold room but instead you have to listen to DunkTales and watch the clip at around 0.3 fps
The janky parts :
As you may know, there is no tool in noita to play video files, this is why you get to see only 54 frames of the video (times just right for a good karaoke)
The game doesn't pause when doing so, you might die, but gold is often a safe place (if you hear that you'r taking damage just mod restart, it will stop the music)
Taking frames from a video makes'em a bit blurry sometimes
If gold is shifted you still get the money
Sometimes, if the chunck isn't fully loaded in there is still a bit of gold left in it
Trigers only once per game
Link to the music : https://youtu.be/xtlPywRdo6M?si=b0nfGcOPw7ZJzCqg Credits to Shankmo for it
